import { AppError } from "../../http/errorCatalog.js"

const INDIA_UTC_OFFSET_MS = 330 * 60 * 1000

export const indiaCalendarDate = (now: Date): string =>

STATIC, not fixed (outside b-support scope): ascending keyset lists compare (created_at, id) > cursor, but the cursor holds iso(row.createdAt) at millisecond precision while created_at has microseconds. The fund receipt queue (findQueuePage, created_at asc) will likely repeat the last row of each page on the next page. Descending lists can instead skip rows within the same millisecond. b-support avoids it by sorting and comparing on date_trunc('milliseconds', created_at). Worth a follow-up task.
